entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.18.0: A sketch of its own, new windows, AI that stays in ProstoCAD
entry.content:
Added

  • The sketch is ProstoCAD's own and stays quick even with many lines: magnets, size boxes at the pointer, the space bar to switch what a tool does, a right-click ring, Rotate, Tangent Arc, copy and paste, constraints on the axes and the origin. Files of earlier versions open as they are.
  • The feature windows are new: in cards, a size pulled by its dot or stepped by the wheel; settings are one panel under ⚙.
  • Connect AI: a new window with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI (a free Google account), each installed and connected with one click; every AI program with its own instructions. The AI works only on the part open in ProstoCAD.
  • Spur Gears: type the center distance you want and keep the Ratio — the window suggests the pair at a standard module, Use sets it.
  • Mac: the Finder shows .FCStd, STL and STEP files as pictures of the part, and the space bar turns the part itself.
  • Much faster on heavy parts: Undo, Redo, OK and the first click; drawings of STL parts about twice as fast; Save several times faster on big parts.

Fixed

  • A sketch with a constraint that only partly adds something (a side Collinear with an axis, a corner on the origin) is kept; it was refused and the changes were lost.
  • Revolve waits for the axis to be clicked instead of choosing one by itself.
